notes: Fresh-node adoption now runs as a background job instead of one long browser request, preventing the page from appearing to stop during package installation.
The adoption page shows the current named stage, percentage, elapsed time, current action and a scrollable history of completed stages.
Installation progress resumes after closing and reopening the adoption page in the same browser tab.
Failed installations remain on screen with the exact failing stage and error, and can be retried safely without losing the diagnostic result.
Node API upload failures and missing bundled files now produce specific plain-English errors instead of an unexplained HTTP 500.
SSH, sudo and NAS credentials remain request-only and are cleared from the background task as soon as it finishes.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.5.
